source: Anti-Aging Questionnaire (Notion export), 15 sections, answered by client

identity.occupation: Entrepreneur — digital media businesses, content creation, startup investing; also studies history, psychology, biology, philosophy, marketing; enrolled in a maths course
identity.primary_goal_verbatim: Better cardio, less fatigue and higher sharpness.
identity.motivation_note: Very high. Friend inspired him, the blood report earlier this year prompted him, and dislike of his mirror image moved him. Highly disciplined daily routine already in place.
identity.time_note: Stated time and budget are effectively unlimited; schedule is self-directed.

body_medical.weight_current_note: 72kg now; peaked 73.1kg last month (May 2026); lowest as adult ~65kg about a year ago. Trending up over the last year.
body_medical.body_fat_distribution: Average-athletic build; gains first at lower belly and love handles; some lower-belly weight but not dominant.

current_medications.name: Otrivin (xylometazoline nasal spray)
current_medications.use: near-daily PRN for chronic one-sided nasal blockage — rebound-congestion risk (rhinitis medicamentosa)

current_medications.name: Albendazole-type deworming tablet
current_medications.use: annual routine deworming; never had a stool test

allergies_intolerances: lactose intolerance — whey concentrate and any lactose causes severe bloating; cannot digest peas

diet.pattern: Heavy non-veg, mostly chicken. Eats non-veg all days except Tue & Thu. NO red meat. Heavy pork only when abroad. Heavy egg eater.
diet.dairy: Lactose-free milk only. Substantial dairy in coffee, milkshakes, and oats-with-yogurt. Previously heavy ghee use. Rarely paneer, no curd (except yogurt), no cheese.
diet.typical_first_meal: Banana, coffee, sometimes a blueberry shake
diet.typical_last_meal: Chicken + rice, sometimes chole + rice (no later than 9pm)
diet.late_night_eating: very rare now; never after dinner (was frequent in 2025)
diet.fasting_pattern: Intermittent fasting Tue & Thu — skips breakfast, first meal ~2pm (≈16:8 twice weekly)
typical_day_of_eating: 09:00 — whey protein, sometimes with eggs or muesli
11:00 — muesli or eggs (if whey skipped earlier)
13:30-14:00 — lunch, heavy with chicken, sometimes eggs + rice
21:00 — dinner, heavy chicken or chole, high-protein + rice
diet.eats_out_frequency: almost never; cafes 1-2x/month; orders meals as plain as possible
diet.who_cooks: Girlfriend cooks (full control over ingredients); he cooks eggs himself
diet.sugary_drinks: never; no sugar in coffee since May 2026
diet.grain_split: Mostly kala namak rice; rarely wheat/roti; multigrain bread is a staple; brown rice ~2x/week; oats almost daily
diet.vegetable_flag: MAJOR GAP — near-zero vegetable intake; dislikes veggies
diet.salt_pickle_processed: very low / almost none; rare pickle or ketchup
diet.diet_quality_note: Diet discipline is exceptional: zero fried food, no sugar, no sugary drinks, no late eating, minimal processed food. The two gaps are near-zero vegetables/fiber and zero red meat (heme iron).

drinks_caffeine_alcohol.caffeine_timing: Morning on empty stomach; when a 2nd cup, usually after lunch
drinks_caffeine_alcohol.caffeine_iron_flag: After-lunch coffee can blunt non-heme iron absorption from the lunch meal — relevant given ferritin 7.5
drinks_caffeine_alcohol.energy_drinks: Monster Zero occasionally on Saturdays before HIIT sessions
drinks_caffeine_alcohol.alcohol_pattern: Very low — once every 3-6 months, but binges through to morning when he does drink

iron_loss_screen.acidity_heartburn: mild acidity only if meals skipped, otherwise none
iron_loss_screen.nsaid_use: Cannot take ibuprofen (allergic). Uses Zerodol SP rarely when injured.
iron_loss_screen.bleeding_gums: YES — gums bleed, including while eating fruit like banana
iron_loss_screen.nasal_bleeding: YES — no overt nosebleeds, but frequently blood attached to nasal mucus
iron_loss_screen.fatigue: Perpetually tired. No dizziness. Heart races sometimes under stress.
iron_loss_screen.cold_hands: YES — people often say his hands are cold (classic iron-deficiency sign)
iron_loss_screen.thermoregulation: Feels hotter generally these days; heavy foot and palm sweating
iron_loss_screen.hair_nails: No hair shedding; hair texture has turned harsh vs 2 years ago; nails strong
iron_loss_screen.bowel_habits: Twice daily, consistent when eating well; erratic/irregular if eating poorly
iron_loss_screen.deworming_history: Routine annual deworming (albendazole-type); never had a stool/parasite test
iron_loss_screen.travel_endemic_exposure: Rural Bihar (family origin), Thailand (Dec 2025), Kasol/mountains — helminth/hookworm consideration for unexplained iron loss
iron_loss_screen.iron_loss_synthesis: Likely multifactorial: (1) zero red-meat / low absorbable heme intake, (2) after-meal coffee blunting non-heme absorption, (3) chronic low-grade mucosal bleeding (gums + nasal mucus, Otrivin-irritated mucosa), (4) very high daily training load with sweat + possible foot-strike hemolysis, (5) unscreened GI/parasitic loss given rural + tropical travel and never-tested stool. Diet alone does not fully explain ferritin 7.5 in a heavy meat-eater — stool occult blood + physician iron workup warranted before high-dose iron.

exercise.strength_session_detail: One session/day, trainer-guided, usually one muscle group (push OR pull), mostly compound movements, 45-90 min
exercise.consistency: On and off for 2 years; super-consistent for the last 4 months; progressing well
exercise.zone2_flag: MAJOR GAP — almost no steady Zone-2 cardio despite 'better cardio' being his #1 goal and cardio being the top lever for his HDL/lipid/insulin picture
exercise.non_exercise_activity: Mostly standing/sitting apart from MMA and gym; very active on feet when abroad
exercise.injuries_limitations: Knee muscles slightly hurt; minor exterior-muscle issue; no explosive knees, knees take a toll if pushed hard
exercise.training_load_flag: Daily MMA + strength + HIIT on ~6h sleep, no rest day = under-recovery risk; feeds fatigue, stress score, and possibly iron picture

sleep_recovery.sleep_duration_flag: ~6h actual is SHORT for his training load and his metabolic/insulin goals
sleep_recovery.night_waking: very rare; can fall back asleep
sleep_recovery.snoring: snores when sleeping on his back
sleep_recovery.apnea_signals: Snoring + chronic one-sided nasal blockage + always-groggy + perpetually tired — worth screening for sleep-disordered breathing / nasal-obstruction-driven poor sleep quality

stress_mood_mind.stress_level_note: Bevel app stress score stays 80+ every day (largely from MMA + gym training load). Relationship is a new and significant stressor — he can no longer wind down the way he used to. Money is a recurring stressor as a business owner.
stress_mood_mind.mood: Has felt low for the last few months. Never anxious generally, but feels some anxiety before/while making a decision.
stress_mood_mind.energy_pattern: Groggy mornings, groggy afternoons, sleepy mid-evenings — frequent. Energy otherwise comes in spikes. Afternoon crash is always imminent (habitually relaxes after lunch). Brain fog was an issue last quarter.
stress_mood_mind.focus_motivation_drive: Quite good — strong focus, motivation never a problem, drive always at peak
stress_mood_mind.burnout: Theoretically thinks he should be near burnout given the load, but doesn't feel close because he loves everything he does
stress_mood_mind.unwind_method: Not really; playing games gets him there when needed
stress_mood_mind.mental_health_screen_note: Persistent low mood over months + chronic high physiological stress + poor sleep quality. Sub-clinical but worth a Mind/Recovery emphasis; recommend a check-in if low mood persists.

energy_mens_health.recovery_after_exertion: usually fine after a good meal
energy_mens_health.note: Testosterone 801 ng/dL is clearly translating to real-world vitality — libido, morning erections, drive all strong. The limiter is recovery, not hormones.

allergy_skin_atopy.rhinitis_detail: Perpetually blocked nose — one side almost always blocked and won't clear; Otrivin gives only temporary relief; pressing the nose triggers sneezing all day
allergy_skin_atopy.ent_flag: One-sided persistent obstruction + Otrivin dependence suggests possible deviated nasal septum +/- rhinitis medicamentosa (rebound from chronic decongestant use). ENT referral worthwhile — also relevant to nasal bleeding and sleep quality.
allergy_skin_atopy.asthma: childhood asthma, no incident since age 14
allergy_skin_atopy.skin: Body skin dry; face very oily; whole body acne-prone
allergy_skin_atopy.hair: Hair has thinned since moving to Noida (possible hard-water / environmental / iron contribution)
allergy_skin_atopy.atopy_synthesis: IgE 247 maps cleanly to a real atopic constitution: perennial allergic rhinitis + pollen allergy + childhood asthma + shellfish anaphylaxis. Confirmed, not incidental.

digestion_gut.bloating: When meals skipped; whey concentrate or any lactose causes severe bloating; cannot digest peas
digestion_gut.stool_consistency: loose more common than constipation when active; constipation rare
digestion_gut.lactose_flag: Confirmed lactose intolerance — keep all protein as ISOLATE (not concentrate); lactose-free milk already in use

substances.smoking_vaping: Very rare smoking/vaping; peaked in 2025, otherwise once a year or none; no gutka/paan
substances.smoking_flag: Even occasional smoking/vaping compounds Lp(a)-driven cardiovascular risk AND irritates nasal/oral mucosa (relevant to bleeding + iron). Strong candidate to eliminate fully.

current_supplements.name: Recalmin-XT
current_supplements.note: calcium/mineral + methylcobalamin — a B12 source; also calcium (can blunt iron absorption if co-timed)

current_supplements.name: NVMe OD
current_supplements.note: neuro/multivit with methylcobalamin — a second B12 source

current_supplements.name: Vitamin D3 60,000 IU
current_supplements.note: explains Vit D 63; this is a loading dose — review vs maintenance since he is already at the top of optimal

current_supplements.name: Multivitamin
current_supplements.note: a third B12/folate source — explains B12 >2000 and folate >24

current_supplements.name: Magnesium Glycinate
current_supplements.note: Mg serum 1.98, just under optimal — continue

current_supplements.name: Vitamin C 500mg
current_supplements.note: REPURPOSE — time with iron-containing meals to boost non-heme iron absorption

substances.supplement_audit_flag: B12 >2000 and folate >24 are from TRIPLE-stacking B12/folate across Recalmin-XT + NVMe + multivitamin. Redundant (not harmful, but pointless). Consolidate. No iron currently in the stack — the key gap, pending physician/cause workup.
substances.recent_illness_1mo: minor cold last month, no fever

constraints.kitchen_access: girlfriend cooks with full ingredient control; can cook (eggs) himself; relies mostly on home-cooked
constraints.biggest_obstacle: Sickness and breaks in routine — hardest to maintain while travelling
constraints.past_attempts: Feels well when eating high-protein food with variety; adding foods he dislikes never sticks long-term
constraints.why_now: Friend's inspiration + this year's blood report + dislike of his mirror image
constraints.ninety_day_goal_verbatim: Better cardio, less fatigue and higher sharpness
constraints.adherence_design_note: Do NOT build around vegetables he won't eat — reach fiber via oats, chia, multigrain, fruit, legumes, and palatable veg-adjacent routes (soups, blended, dal). Design must survive travel. He will adhere to almost anything framed as performance, given his discipline.

environment.city_aqi_tier: high — Noida/NCR is among the most polluted Indian metros, severe Oct-Feb
environment.aqi_flag: High AQI is relevant to his atopic rhinitis (trigger), training-outdoors decisions, and cardiovascular risk. Favor indoor/filtered-air Zone-2 during high-AQI months.
environment.hair_environment_note: Hair thinning began after moving to Noida — possible hard water / environmental contributor

mental_health.burnout_self_assessment: denies, attributes resilience to loving his work
mental_health.screen_note: Sub-clinical low mood + chronically elevated physiological stress + short/groggy sleep. Not a clinical flag, but justifies Mind + Recovery as lead domains alongside the cardio/iron work.
